protocol: 10-day water-only complete fast, then refeeding; capillary glucose and BHB every morning, venous blood at 07:00 on BF1, CF3, CF6, CF9, CR3, FR5
population: 13 men, 39.6 +/- 7.9 y, BMI 24.6 +/- 3.5, no chronic illness
note: Glucose and BHB are quoted at selected days in the text; daily curves are in a figure; other tables are blood counts and nutrition markers.
